item.title: Phenom showcases new ordered tier list for Street Fighter 6
item.description: <p>NIP|<a href='https://x.com/PhenomSF/status/2004738370820599814'>Phenom</a> recently decided to release a new ordered tier list for <a href='https://www.eventhubs.com/moves/sf6/'>Street Fighter 6</a> as a way of celebrating the holiday season. This tier list is seemingly accounting for the <a href='https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/dec/14/balance-changes-street-fighter-6/'>balance patch</a> that dropped for Street Fighter 6 earlier this month that nerfed Mai while buffing Sagat and Elena.</p

item.title: Current generation consoles could potentially see another price hike, AI said to be at the root of the problem this time
item.description: <p>It's becoming very expensive to be a gamer. The PlayStation 5 Digital Edition costs nearly $499. Those that want improved performance with the PlayStation 5 Pro better be prepared to spend upwards of $749.</p> <p>Meanwhile, the cheapest version of the latest Xbox console, the Xbox Series S 512GB, recently saw a <a href='https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/may/01/xbox-price-hike/'>price hike</a> from $299.99 to $379.99. The Xbox Series X 2TB Galaxy Special Edition went from $599.99 to $729.99.

item.title: Capcom vs. Square fan-made fighting game demo released, so Street Fighter and Final Fantasy can finally clash outside of Smash Bros.
item.description: <p>Back in the '90s, Capcom and Square were on top of the gaming world, but we never really got to see the fighting game and RPG legends team up officially outside of Super Smash Bros.</p> <p>That's finally changing now, however, though unofficially through the Capcom vs. Square: Parallel Destinies fan-made fighting game.</p>

item.title: 2XKO appears to leak its console and Season 1 release date... again
item.description: <p>2XKO has been in the hands of PC players for a few months already, and it seems now we know when console owners can get in on the action too.</p> <p>Riot Games appears to have accidentally posted a trailer early that leaked their own Season 1 release date.</p>

item.title: Katsuhiro Harada shares New Year's messages on the future as his time with Tekken and Bandai Namco is now over
item.description: <p>After decades under the same leadership, Tekken is now entering a brand new era moving into 2026.</p> <p>It appears that longtime Tekken Director Katsuhiro Harada is officially gone from Bandai Namco.</p>
